lane:
مَلَابٌ a Persian word, (TA,) _A kind of perfume,_ (S, K,) _like_ خَلُوق (S): or _saffron._ (IAar, K.) === مَلَابَةٌ _A fascicle,_ or _small bundle, of filaments of saffron; a shive of saffron._ (IAar).

مَلَابٌ : see art. لوب, in which, as well as here, it is mentioned in the K.

entries.text: الملاب، كسحاب: عطر، أو الزعفران، وذكر في: ل وب.
